about: A simulated week of the daily loop, 11 to 17 November 2026: stories are added to the backlog on the day they surfaced, the list is ranked each morning, five are published under the mix rules, and published stories are marked in data/backlog.json. Stories were found by one-off fetches, a model triage of headlines and agent source checks, not by the live pull.
